scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/shared && concurrently -k -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/server" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/server && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run test -w apps/server && npm run test -w apps/web
